document_title: Week 1 Task: Data Science Project Planning and Strategy Design
project_name: T20 Cricket Match Score Prediction & Performance Analytics

content.subtitle: Hypothetical Problem
content.text: T20 franchise cricket generates vast amounts of ball-by-ball data, but teams often struggle to translate raw statistics into real-time, actionable strategies. A data science approach utilizing Python can identify hidden patterns in player matchups, pitch conditions, and venue history.

content.subtitle: Motivation
content.text: Predicting match outcomes and optimizing player selection using data-driven insights provides a competitive edge in high-stakes tournaments.

content.subtitle: Objectives
content.text:
1. Develop a machine learning model to predict the first-innings score based on the first 6 overs (Powerplay).
2. Analyze player matchups (e.g., specific batter vs. spin bowlers) to recommend optimal playing XIs.

content.subtitle: In-Scope
content.text: Historical ball-by-ball data, player statistics, venue data, and toss decisions.

content.subtitle: Out-of-Scope
content.text: Real-time weather forecasting, ticket sales analytics, and stadium attendance metrics.

content.subtitle: Data Collection
content.text: Acquire historical T20 match datasets containing ball-by-ball logs.

content.subtitle: Data Cleaning
content.text: Handle missing values in player names, standardize venue names, and filter out rain-affected or truncated matches.

content.subtitle: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
content.text: Visualize run rates across different phases of the game and plot player strike rates against specific bowling types.

content.subtitle: Modeling
content.text: Train regression models for score prediction and classification models for match-winner prediction.

content.subtitle: Evaluation
content.text: Use metrics like Mean Absolute Error (MAE) for score prediction and accuracy/F1-score for win classification.

content.text: EDA & Visualization (Python libraries: matplotlib, seaborn, plotly).

content.subtitle: Phase 4 (Hours 21-30)
content.text: Model Building & Evaluation (Python libraries: scikit-learn, xgboost).

content.subtitle: Phase 5 (Hours 31-35)
content.text: Final Review & Documentation (Tools: Jupyter Notebook, MS Word).

content.subtitle: Expected Outcomes
content.text: A robust predictive model capable of estimating scores with a defined margin of error, and a comprehensive dashboard mapping key player matchups.

content.subtitle: Anticipated Challenges
content.text: High variance in T20 matches, changes in squad compositions, and sparse data for newly debuted players.

content.subtitle: Mitigation Strategy
content.text: Implement rolling averages for player form rather than relying solely on career statistics, and utilize ensemble learning methods to handle variance.
